rules.title: RSO Additional Tenant Rent Increase
rules.requirement: Landlords may increase rent by 10% for an additional tenant (not dependent) who moves into a rental unit, within 60 days of learning about the additional tenant.
rules.quoted_span: However, a 10% for an additional tenant is allowed (not a dependent) if moves into a rental unit: Landlords can increase the rent within 60 days of learning about the additional tenant
rules.coverage_conditions: Additional tenant (not dependent) moves into unit; within 60 days of landlord learning of additional tenant
rules.exemptions: Does not apply if the additional occupant is a dependent; rent increases for unauthorized additional tenants who moved between March 2020 and December 2023 require advance written notice by March 1, 2024

rules.title: RSO Just Cause Eviction - Fault-Based Grounds
rules.requirement: Landlords may evict tenants for cause including: failure to pay rent, failure to fix or address a violation of the rental agreement, creating a nuisance or causing damage, using the unit for an illegal purpose, failure to renew a similar rental agreement, failure to provide reasonable access, or if the person at lease term is an unapproved subtenant.
rules.citation: LAHD RSO Overview, September 22, 2026; Los Angeles Municipal Code 151.09.C.9 & 165.05.B.5
rules.quoted_span:
Tenant is at-fault
Failure to pay rent
Failure to fix or address a violation of the rental agreement
Creating a nuisance or causing damage to the rental unit
Using the rental unit for an illegal purpose
Failure to renew a similar rental agreement
Failure to provide the landlord with reasonable access to the rental unit
The person at the end of the lease term is a subtenant not approved by the landlord
rules.coverage_conditions: All RSO-covered rental units in Los Angeles

rule.title: RSO Rent Increase - Allowable Annual Percentage
rule.requirement: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage as determined by LAHD. The specific percentage is referenced in an external PDF document.
rule.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage (click here to view the allowable rent increase PDF)
rule.coverage_conditions: Certificate of occupancy on or before October 1, 1978; unit type includes apartments, condominiums (pre-1996 tenancies), townhomes (pre-1996 tenancies), duplexes, two or more single-family units on same parcel, hotel/motel/rooming house rooms occupied 30+ consecutive days, residential units attached to commercial, ADUs, JADUs, mobile homes and recreational vehicles in mobile home parks
rule.exemptions: Exemptions apply when tenant voluntarily moves out, does not pay rent and is evicted, violates lease and is evicted, is evicted for failure to comply with Tenant Habitability Plan, is evicted per City Attorney order, or accepts a Tenant Buyout Agreement
